text:
Before: 2 slices of sourdough toast (~50g each, ~130 kcal each, so ~260 kcal), 2 fried or poached eggs (~92 kcal total for 2 eggs ~100g, about 180 kcal if fried), 2 butter pats (~7g each, ~50 kcal total), and a cup of tea with milk (~20 kcal).

After: some toast remains, about 1 slice equivalent in pieces, perhaps 40% of the toast. Egg remnants are small, maybe 15% left. Both butter pats were used. The tea appears finished.

Toast eaten: about 60% of 100g = 60g, about 160 kcal.
Eggs eaten: about 85% of 100g = 85g, about 150 kcal.
Butter: about 12g, about 85 kcal. Two pats at 7g would be roughly 100 kcal; the containers look mostly empty, so ~12g and ~85 kcal.
Tea: about 10 kcal, with 250g of liquid. I'll count it, since it was consumed, but the tea is only a drink and the question is about food energy, so I'll include the small kcal.

Total: 160 + 150 + 85 + 10 = 405 kcal.
Mass: 60 + 85 + 12 + 200 (tea) = ~357g. I'll exclude the tea mass to keep it as food, giving ~157g, plus tea ≈ 350g. I'll go with including the tea.
